parsed.post: Discarding 1.0453 (worse than 1.0122). It seems LR 0.05 is a decent baseline for depth 6, but we need to find if higher LR or smaller batch sizes (more steps) help convergence within 5 mins. Testing smaller batch size next to increase gradient updates per budget.
parsed.description: Reducing TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE from 524288 to 262144 to increase the number of gradient steps within the 5-minute training window, aiming for better convergence at DEPTH=6.
